subject: Forecast signal: checklist for board packet & runway confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmehealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-10T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Forecast signal — Q2 ARR implications

Sergio,

Quick note from finance: leadership wants confirmation of timing for the Acme Health renewal before we finalize the board packet. We have a board deadline on 2027-02-18 and need to know whether to include the $1.2M ARR as committed for Q2 or list it as at-risk.

Can you confirm:
- Expected signed SOW date / any outstanding approvals on your side
- Final ARR posture (commit vs. upside) you plan to present
- Any material concessions we should disclose (credits / timing differences)

I attached a copy of the procurement deck they circulated on their side for reference (procurement_deck_v1.pdf).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Soto
Director, Procurement
Acme Health

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmehealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivev_kulkarni <vivev.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-11T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Forecast signal — Q2 ARR implications

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the deck. High level: we expect to sign the SOW this week pending one final procurement note (delivery window). I want to be conservative for the board packet but ensure the narrative is clear.

Requests from our side to close this cleanly:
- Sales: confirm stage updated to "Legal/Sign" with a target signature date (screenshot or HubSpot link)
- CS: confirm onboarding start window and whether the commercial terms include any ramp credits
- Finance: provide any required evidence for revenue recognition (signed SOW, PO, DocuSign link)

Attached: forecast_template_Q2.xlsx — please fill the highlighted columns (expected close date, recognized ARR this quarter vs. next quarter, any one-off credits).

If we get the signed SOW by EOD Thu (2027-02-12), I will present it as committed in the board packet; otherwise it will be captured as upside with notes.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Current finance note for internal modeling (quick):
- If signed SOW arrives by 2027-02-12 EOD: count $1,200,000 as Q2 committed ARR (recognition starts on contract effective date; model shows full annual ARR counted as committed in Q2 guidance)
- If signing slips into next fiscal period: classify as upside and show impact in the sensitivity slide (+$1.2M ARR upside)
- No customer-requested credits beyond nominal 30-day onboarding credit (estimated $18k)

I updated the bookings model and the impact is visible under Deal ID DEAL-4821 in the board folder. I will attach the signed_SOW_acme_4821.pdf to the folder once the envelope clears.

— Vivev

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T14:02:00-05:00
Subject: SUMMARY: Board packet asks — Acme Health (DEAL-4821)

Team — closing the loop for board pack preparation. Below is the final checklist and owner list. Board deck deadline: 2027-02-18 EOB.

Final checklist (what I need by 2027-02-16 12:00 PM ET):
1) Signed SOW / DocuSign envelope ID — owner: vanessa_ortiz — deliverable: PDF in Drive and DocuSign link (attachment: signed_SOW_acme_4821.pdf)
2) HubSpot stage screenshot + HubSpot link — owner: vanessa_ortiz — deliverable: screenshot uploaded to board folder
3) Finance note on recognition posture and any credit impact — owner: vivev_kulkarni — deliverable: short memo (1 paragraph) in Drive
4) Forecast template completed (expected close date + ARR recognition split) — owner: neha_kapoor — deliverable: forecast_template_Q2.xlsx updated
5) Short narrative blurb for slide (1–2 lines) stating whether revenue is being shown as committed or upside — owner: sergio_alvarez — deliverable: text in the board doc

If any of the above fails to land by the deadline, we will present the deal as upside and include a 1-line note explaining the outstanding legal approval. Elena — thanks for the transparency; we'll confirm final posture once we receive DocuSign.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Revenue Operations
